- 2026-08-29 | NO-FINDING | mcp-auth | Reviewed mcp_server/mcp_server/{auth,storage,server,gateway_bridge}.py end to end plus config.py's canonical_resource/redirect allowlist and NEXT_STEPS.md; hypotheses checked and killed: redirect_uri canonicalization bypass (query/fragment stripping only affects claude.ai's own callback, not attacker-controlled hosts), txn-cookie CSRF, completed-login replay oracle, refresh/access token-type confusion in storage.py (separate dicts, no collision), audience binding bypass via `resource`, timing side channel on password length via hmac.compare_digest, DCR client_id/redirect_uri cross-client authorize() confusion (deliberately global-allowlist by design per module docstring), TOCTOU on oauth-store.json permissions (already a known/deprioritized LOW in NEXT_STEPS.md, only exposes SHA-256 hashes), and a Python/Elixir whitespace-splitting mismatch in the `/restart` colon-exemption guard (provably symmetric — Elixir's ASCII-only `\s` is a subset of Python's `str.split(None)`, so no bypass direction exists). The area has had two hardening rounds already (2026-08-10, 2026-08-25) with thorough test coverage; the real finding this run turned out to be reachable from the same code path (`/restart` in chat content) but rooted in the shared gateway module (`lib/tri_onyx/system_command.ex`), not the Python server itself.
